story_overview: Kenshin, a large and imposing man, finds himself in a conflict with the scheming Marco and a security guard, Kenji. The situation escalates from an antique mall to a mysterious white facility where doubles of Kenji appear and a strange blue smoke is weaponized. A young girl, Mila, also gets involved after an encounter with Kenji at the Japan Expo, connecting her to the unfolding strange events.
